A Ketch is an Eliksni carrier ship, often used to pillage the planets once owned by humanity before the Collapse. Ketches are presumably equipped with their own jump drives to traverse long distances in relatively short amounts of time. They appear to be as large or larger than some colony ships with enough room to hold several Skiffs. The Awoken fleet that was led by Mara Sov against Oryx, the Taken King was composed of many former Wolf Ketches. While they destroyed or damaged much of the Hive battlegroup, the Dreadnaught itself remained undamaged, and proceeded to destroy them.

Legendary Marks are a currency used to purchase weapons, armor, and resources from Vanguard, Crucible, and faction vendors in the Tower. Guardians can earn Legendary Marks beginning at level 18 and are limited to an inventory cap of 200. Marks are shared by all Guardians on a player's account. In Destiny 2, Legendary Marks were added with the Monument of Triumph update, and are used to purchase a variety of rewards from the Monument's vendors. They are limited to an inventory cap of 9,999 and are shared by all Guardians on a player's account.
